ThingDef.label: Darth Revan's Armor
ThingDef.description:
Created by the mystical technology of the Star Forge, these robes focus the dark side energies of the wearer, fueling their power. The Sith Lord Darth Revan was wearing similar robes when captured by the Jedi, who viewed the garments as an abomination and destroyed them. However the Jedi Council, not being familiar with the origins of the robes, were unaware that the Star Forge would be capable of producing an item of such terrible power a second time.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Armor Underlay (robe)
- Armor Overlay

ThingDef.label: Darth Revan's Mask
ThingDef.description:
Hero, villain, this legendary mask symbolizes the pivotal moment that started it all.

ThingDef.label: Darth Nihilus' Robes
ThingDef.description:
Robe once belonging to Darth Nihilus, who fell by the hand of the Exile. Even years after his death, this garment still carries within it a fragment of Darth Nihilus' spirit and his insatiable hunger.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Armor Underlay (robe)

ThingDef.label: Darth Nihilus' Mask
ThingDef.description: Mask formerly owned by Darth Nihilus, whose spirit was bound within it. Once a symbol of its owner's boundless hunger, it is now a coveted and powerful artifact - a relic for every Dark Side adept.

ThingDef.label: Darth Nihilus' Cloak
ThingDef.description: Cloak once worn by Darth Nihilus, who was slain by the Exile. As black as the remnants of Darth Nihilus' soul.

ThingDef.label: Star Forge Robes
ThingDef.description:
Created by the mystical technology of the Star Forge, these robes focus the inherent Force abilities of the wearer, fueling their power. Although the Star Forge itself is an artifact of the dark side, these robes were customised using an analysis of the Jedi they were created for, resulting in a powerful light side item that the Jedi can safely use against their enemies without fear of taint or corruption.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Armor Underlay (robe)
- Armor Overlay

ThingDef.label: Star Forge Mask
ThingDef.description:
Though it wasn't Revan's original mask, this perfect replica was created alongside the Star Forge Robes by a redeemed Revan preparing to face Darth Malak one final time.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Headgear Underlay
- Visor Tech

ThingDef.label: Darth Sion's Armor
ThingDef.description:
While it was hard to call these cast-offs armor like those worn by soldiers or adepts of the Force, the protection of the legs, pelvis, and dominant arm was more than enough for someone whose body was constantly brought back to life by the dark side of the Force and who could not die. After all, its former owner preferred the freedom from restraint to protection from weapons that did not harm him.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Armor Underlay (robe)
- Armor Overlay

ThingDef.label: Darth Traya's Robes
ThingDef.description:
Robe once worn by the manipulative Darth Traya. Now, it is more of a symbolic relic of its former owner’s forgotten philosophy than a powerful Dark Side artifact.

UPGRADE SLOTS:

ThingDef.description:
Attributed to Exar Kun, this armor may well have been one of those worn by the Dark Lord prior to his defeat forty years ago. He was rarely without considerable, yet flexible, personal armor.
